messages:
ana_sales: Quick help please. Customer redlined with an MFN clause tied to any "published customer-facing price" and a 12-month non-increase. They also asked for 'no surcharge' on data egress and a promo cap of $0.014/token for marketing campaigns. POC in 5 days.

pete_dealdesk: MFN tied to published prices is scary because we run limited-time promos and marketplace discounts. Need to narrow MFN and add carve-outs. For the surcharge ask, can we say 'standard cloud egress charges apply' but exclude as a commercial concession?

lori_legal: I'll propose limiting MFN to "sustained commercial offers" and exclude marketplace, reseller, and one-off partnerships. Also add a clause that price protection excludes taxes and third-party surcharges.

max_ps: POC note: they're planning to route heavy inference to our hosted API during the test. If they claim MFN applies to all usage tiers, we'll be constrained later when we roll out new micro-batch optimizations. Ask: add 'usage pattern' carve-out and true-up.

ravi_se: Pricing calc: list = $0.02/token. If we offer a 20% discount on a $150k commit, that's $0.016/token. A promo cap at $0.014 would erode margin on high volume. Suggest we keep promo cap tied to specific marketing vehicles and exclude partner co-funded promos.

ana_sales: I mean ana_sales above. We'll request: limited MFN (same package & spend), carve-outs for short promos and marketplace, require a minimum commit for 12-month hold, and clarify egress surcharge treatment.

pete_dealdesk: I'll draft commit bands and loop in revops.

lori_legal: I'll send a redline with MFN limited to offers >=90 days, carve-outs for marketplace/reseller, and explicit exclusion for taxes/surcharges. We'll also require commitment threshold for price hold.

ana_sales: Thanks 1f44d; will wait for draft before pushing to customer.
